newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Grindrod unit buys chemical carrier.
newsitem.headline: Grindrod unit buys chemical carrier.

text.p: A South African tanker liner, Unicorn Tankers, announced on Monday its debut into the international chemicals shipping trade through the purchase of a 13,947 deadweight tonne specialist chemical carrier.

A spokesman for Unicorn Tankers -- part of the Grindrod Unicorn Group -- Alan Olivier said the purchase of the carrier named "May Fair 1" represented the first occasion in which South African chemical imports and exports will be carried in a South African owned ship.
"With the purchase of the vessel...Unicorn Tankers...enters a significant and growing new market in the international tanker trade," he said in a statement.

The six-year-old carrier will participate in the Austrialian-based Botany Bay Parcel Tankers International Pool (BBPTI) fleet which operates a worldwide chemical parcel service in South Africa, the United States, Asia, Australia and South America, Olivier added.
He said "May Fair 1" had 10 stainless steel centre tanks and seven pairs of specially coated wing tanks for the carriage of a large variety of sensitive cargoes.
BBPT was created in 1990 and is one of the world's leading carriers of speciality liquid products and chemicals.
